header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Aziz Ahmed Laghari, advocate for the petitioner
Mr. Ghulamullah Memon, A.A.G a/w S.S.P Mirpurkhas, D.S.P
body: Shujjabad, S.H.O P.S Taluka and Incharge Legal Cell, Mirpurkhas = This petition was filed only with the prayer that the absconder accused namely Yar Muhammad Laghari be arrested.
After notices, respondents filed their comments which are taken on record.

Today, S.S.P Mirpurkhas is also present and undertakes that within the shortest period of time, absconder accused Yar Muhammad Laghari shall be arrested. On his undertaking, this petition is disposed of with directions to the S.S.P Mirpurkhas to arrest the absconder accused Yar Muhammad Laghari and produce him in the court having jurisdiction within 90 days.
